name: Generic 22-inch class monitor with a paintable screen
build: blender -b --factory-startup --python source/build_desktop_generic.py, then glTF-Transform dedup → weld → meshopt
units: metres; origin at the centre of the base; screen faces +Z in three.js
textures: none in the asset. The picture is NOT geometry: the mesh named `screen` carries a 0..1 UV map and a scene paints it at runtime (OE3D.screenPainter) — so one model can show a browser error, a lesson page, or anything else a film needs, with no new asset.

anchors.screen: the centre of the picture, just in front of the glass — for a callout that points at what is on screen

meshes.screen: the picture surface: UV (0,0) bottom-left, (1,1) top-right, as the canvas is drawn

behaviour: none of its own: a monitor shows what the computer sends it.

provenance.origin: original work, authored for OE by the explainer engine (procedural Blender script)
provenance.creator: OE Support explainer engine
provenance.license: OE-owned; no third-party geometry, textures or trademarks. The browser drawn on the screen is generic: no product's chrome, no real page.
